name: Full Preparation for Section Sprints
outcome: Every section sprint fully prepped. ACs revised, test strategy aligned, harness cleaned up, ghost gates defined, dev constraints written, 10 section specs drafted and ready for execution.
acceptanceCriteria: E-013.AC1: 10 section audits complete — code vs manifest comparison for each section with file:line evidence
E-013.AC2: 10 section descriptions drafted — ready for operator edit
E-013.AC3: ACCEPTANCE.md revised — all manifest gaps have ACs (chat history delete/scroll, agent/human filter, form submissions, web call VAPI, RBAC super admin, billing data)
E-013.AC4: Test file map — one authoritative .spec.ts per section, old files disposition documented
E-013.AC5: Ghost gate criteria defined per section — evidence requirements, verification checks, pass/fail rules
E-013.AC6: Dev harness constraints per section — declared files, UI permissions, scope limits
E-013.AC7: Governance files cleaned — issues.md, backlog.md, sprints.json, hardwonknowledge.md all current
E-013.AC8: 10 section sprint specs written to .governor/sprint-specs/
E-013.AC9: Priority labels (T1/T2/T3) applied to all ACs and section sprints
E-013.AC10: Operator has edited and approved all 10 section descriptions
E-013.AC11: Test suite reconciliation — I-110 fixed (hardcoded URLs → env var), I-103 fixed (always-true assertions replaced), I-104 decided (keep/delete stubs), deprecated domain-* files archived
E-013.AC12: Pre-existing issues mapped — I-103/I-104/I-106/I-107/I-109/I-110/I-111 assigned to appropriate sprint specs
E-013.AC13: Uncommitted changes resolved — I-109 committed or stashed, clean git state
E-013.AC14: Baseline test run — all s0-s8 spec files executed, pass/fail documented per AC, results saved to evidence
wholeProductFit: This sprint is the bridge between E-012 findings and section-by-section remediation. Without it, every section sprint starts with discovery work that should have been done upfront.

priorityTiers.T1: Data integrity and external data flow — data lands in the right place, integrations pass data correctly, webhooks fire correctly, CRM sync accurate
priorityTiers.T2: Internal features users interact with daily — metrics accuracy, campaign execution, chat quality, agent functionality, data display correctness
priorityTiers.T3: Advanced configuration, governance, appearance — settings, sub-agent management, chat governance, knowledge base, theme
